notablePrerequisites: Sporoloth Ancient has at least three spore counters on it.
description:
Activate Sporoloth Ancient by removing two spore counters from it, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield as a Forest land due to Life and Limb, Evolution Sage triggers twice, putting two spore counters on Sporoloth Ancient.
Repeat.
